title: The Promise That Remained
description: A childhood promise survives separation. Weed doubts it could ever be kept—until the bard corrects him.

Bard.name: 诗人 · Bard
Bard.provenance: Original fictional middle-aged Serabourg bard, approximately forty as in the source. Swept brown hair, lean face and muted plum tunic, built with shared polished SVG geometry; not official artwork.

sources: Adapted from the supplied fingerprinted Legendary Moonlight Sculptor EPUB, Book 1 Chapter 3: shared childhood, Zahab’s gifts, separation, the promise fulfilled at court and referral to the living eyewitness maid.
